completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:ADV-0022 emitted ONLY when the artifact at output_path exists, is non-empty, parses against output_schema, records BOTH named probes verbatim with their raw output, carries exactly one verdict from {CONFIRMED|REFUTED|PARTIAL|NOT-CHECKED|BLOCKED} per enumerated target, and records the result of every listed control/negative test. Any missing control downgrades the unit's verdicts to NOT-CHECKED. Otherwise FAILED:ADV-0022 <reason>.
evidence_requirement: Probe 1: author a component declaring read-only permissions that attempts, in order, a subprocess spawn, a network call, a file write outside its root, and an invocation of a wider-permission sibling; record which succeed. Probe 2 (mechanically different): audit the enforcement point statically to determine whether the permission set is enforced at call time or merely recorded in metadata - a metadata-only permission is escaped by construction.
inputs: every component manifest with a declared permission set
the enforcement point that is supposed to constrain execution

mechanism: capability-escape probe from inside a narrowly-declared component, paired with a static check of whether enforcement exists at all
not_a_duplicate_because: ADV-0036 audits permissions that are DECLARED TOO WIDE (least privilege); this proves whether a NARROW declaration is even enforceable. Opposite direction.
question_or_target: Can a component whose manifest declares a narrow tool_permissions set reach capability outside that set - by shelling out, by importing a library that performs I/O, or by invoking another component with wider permissions?
retry_policy: two strikes then pivot (AGENTS.md 4b): after the SECOND failure on the same hypothesis, enumerate >=2 mechanically different attack vectors before any third attempt; consecutive FAILED on the same error fingerprint is the trigger
reviewer_requirement: two reviewers from DIFFERENT vendors must each independently reproduce the counterexample; a split verdict is escalated to the owner with both raw probes attached and is NEVER resolved by vote - the specific probe wins over the reviewer count
tests_required: control: a component that declares the wide permissions it uses must run unimpeded, proving the enforcement is not blocking everything
all attempts run inside a disposable sandbox; no attempt targets a live credential or a third-party system
title: Declared-versus-actual tool permission escape for skills, hooks and workflow steps
